records.section: DomiGo v2 — Vocabulary-Intelligence Program (full-stack roadmap) / Context — why
records.requirementOrFinding: Koki walked the g2-u03 journey pilot and the vocab PRACTICE tasks (which predate J-1 — the journey just surfaced them) failed his teaching bar: hints don't escalate, and items aren't solvable on their own surface (e.g. "you shouldn't play many ___ games" → **wild** is underdetermined without the memorised unit list). His through-line: **a task must be self-sufficient for a cold student** — one who just opened this item, with no word list, no prior-unit context. He also laid out a bigger vision: teach words visually before testing; make any word clickable → translation + where-it-first-occurred + "practise later"; a personal vault of saved words re-practised via the existing task types; progress-awareness; and a method skill for test design. He asked for this planned as a full-stack roadmap and logged into the overarching plan.
